description: Per-image distortion d=k_M MSE+k_P LPIPS (HiFiC §3.2 before Eq. (3)); defaults k_M=0.075·2^-5 and k_P=1.0 (Appendix A.6). MSE uses raw RGB [0,255], while caller-provided per-image AlexNet net-lin v0.1 LPIPS uses images scaled by 1/255 (official tensorflow/compression models/hific/model.py:546-559,768-797; configs.py:28-44). Implements the distortion term only, without the rate or adversarial terms.

examples.title: Train an image reconstructor with HiFiC distortion

name: HiFiC MSE-plus-LPIPS distortion

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts required lpips_distance and optional mse_weight and lpips_weight; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because image distortion has no ignored indices
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point raw RGB prediction with shape [B,3,H,W] and positive dimensions, on the 0–255 pixel scale
parameters.lpips_distance: required floating-point per-image AlexNet net-lin v0.1 LPIPS scores with shape [B], computed on prediction and targets divided by 255; a scalar is accepted only for B=1
parameters.lpips_weight: finite nonnegative real coefficient for LPIPS distance (default 1.0, HiFiC Appendix A.6)
parameters.mse_weight: finite nonnegative real coefficient for pixel MSE (default 0.00234375 = 0.075 * 2^-5, HiFiC Appendix A.6)
parameters.reduction: none returns [B] per-image distortions, mean averages the batch, or sum totals it (default mean)
parameters.targets: floating-point raw RGB targets matching prediction shape, dtype, and device, on the 0–255 pixel scale
